name: 蛊真人 GU ZHEN REN  Reverend Insanity
detailed_description:
Five hundred years ago in your past life, you were an immortal adept specializing in the blood path. You forcefully refined the Spring and Autumn Cicada, and were driven to self-detonate and be reborn, returning to the past.

Do you want to change everything from your previous life? Break free from your destiny? Come and give it a try.

Game Content: This is a first-person role-playing game. You will play the role of a demon from another world who has traveled through time, experiencing and attempting to become a Nine Revolutions Exalted. Harsh battles and heroes from various eras await you. You must use your combat strategies to ensure that you don't end up dead in the wilderness. During the journey, players may also encounter like-minded companions, and of course, you can also go it alone.

The game takes place in a fantasy world called the World of Gu. In the World of Gu, you will play as Gu Yue Fang Yuan, who was reborn with the Spring and Autumn Cicada. You will embark on adventures together with companions who have diverse personalities and unique abilities, defeat powerful enemies, find your lost relatives, and gradually uncover the truth of "immortality."

By playing this game, you will be able to experience the plot of the novel "The Great Love Celestial Venerable," obtain Gu insects, formulate deadly moves, advance the plot, and refine Gu insects. Discover a wide variety of tasks and get to know many companions. Step by step, improve your cultivation level and enjoy the exhilarating pleasure of leveling up.

This is a small game about the "Gu Adept" made by the author during his off-duty time, aiming to restore the plot of the novel. It's a free game made out of love and developed by an individual. The game is simple, and your understanding is greatly appreciated.

In the World of Gu, you will play as Gu Yue Fang Yuan.
